initialExam.title: KPSC KAS 2026
initialExam.description: Karnataka Administrative Service exam for state civil service posts in Karnataka.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS-I (100Q) + GS-II (100Q). Mains: Kannada, English, GS papers, Optional. Personality Test.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers, 300 marks. Mains: Multiple papers. Personality Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Personality Test → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Commissioner, DSP, and Karnataka state civil service posts
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit kpsc.kar.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Medical, Pension
